title: 叩长安 v5
prompt: Chinese opera-pop fusion, 74BPM, D minor pentatonic. ALL vocals must be sung 戏腔/悲腔, NEVER spoken word, NEVER rap, NEVER 念白, NEVER whispering narration, NEVER a talking voice. If a line looks like dialogue, still sing it with melody. Opening 8 seconds: male 戏腔 vocalize 啊—— with jinghu answering, no talking. Verse also sung in restrained 戏腔, not pop speech-singing. Chorus is full 悲腔 with slides and held notes, tearful but pitched. Bridge is still sung 戏腔, higher, no recitation. Middle instrumental interlude MUST be a Chinese opera ensemble: jinghu lead, yueqin, small gong, clappers 板鼓, muted luo hits, short suona calls, not a modern pop guzheng loop. Second interlude: pipa plus jinghu, then one bar of complete silence, then chorus. Instruments enter and exit gradually. Real human opera-tinged male vocal, in tune, emotional, no spoken adlibs, no background talking, no radio voice. No EDM, no trap, no English, no dialogue.
lyrics:
[Intro]
啊——
雾漫过层层高台

[Verse 1]
灯叠半卷旧稿
长夜独自 待到天稍晓
脚步踏遍寒峭
眼底曾向 远路远眺

[Interlude]
(戏曲过门：京胡领奏，月琴弹拨，板鼓轻敲，小锣点缀，唢呐短音，无人声)

[Pre-Chorus]
肩上驮着 几分期盼
云雾隔断 望不尽远山
尚且不愿 就此离散
只是心力 早已耗完

[Interlude]
(京胡与琵琶对答三小节，第四小节全休止)

[Chorus]
雾漫过层层高台
半生奔走 困在了尘埃
微光难入 世俗眼台
任凭风雨 反复掩埋
霜铺满蜿蜒长阶
孤身一程 无人来相偕
万千期许 尽数撕裂
心底余火 不肯熄灭

[Bridge]
笔墨难换一纸交代
锋芒沉落在人海之内
世间只论 成败的黑白
谁去数 跌过多少来回
攀不上 那一重楼台
便守心火 于尘世之内
纵然埋进 茫茫尘霭
未将本心 就此销毁

[Chorus]
雾漫过层层高台
半生奔走 困在了尘埃
霜铺满蜿蜒长阶
心底余火 不肯熄灭

[Outro]
喧嚣归于夜色寂寥
旧梦仍在 心底轻摇
我到不了 云间远峤
未曾丢掉 当年的年少
啊——
[End]
